# Real rates of fire - before / after (GENERATED by docs/tools/gen_weapon_rof.py)

TTK = time to kill from the first round, every round hitting, no armour/location multiplier: (rounds - 1) x delay. 100 HP = AI and MP; 50 HP = Hardcore. Damage changes only where TTK moved more than 20%.

Avg TTK = the continuous form (round count un-rounded: the average across hit locations); the retune holds it inside the band. 'free' = exempt by weapon_rof_tune.tsv (the before value was an artifact).

## Turret machine guns (AI gunners)

An AI on a turret fired every server frame (40 a second = 2,400 rpm). Now each round leaves at the gun's real rate and carries the rounds it replaces (frame rate / real rate, capped x2.5), so an MG 42 nest keeps its lethality in half the rounds and a .30 cal - slower for real - is about half as dangerous as before.
